club.name: Eden Roskill Cricket Club
club.tagline: Auckland cricket since 1903. Keith Hay Park, Mt Roskill.

homepage.hero_heading: One Club. One Crest. One Standard.
homepage.hero_sub: Eden Roskill Cricket Club — Auckland's home of Premier cricket since 1903. From junior development to Premier grade, we build cricketers and people.
homepage.cta_sub: Register for the 2025/26 season through PlayHQ and join one of Auckland's oldest cricket clubs.

about.heading: More than a cricket club.
about.intro: Eden Roskill is one of Auckland's most multicultural cricket clubs. From Premier grade to junior development, we welcome players of every background, age, and ability. If you love cricket, there's a place for you here.
about.history: Eden Roskill Cricket Club has been a cornerstone of Auckland cricket since 1903. Originally established as separate entities, Eden and Roskill merged in 1952 to form the club known today.
about.value_1_desc: We believe the hours put in off the field define what happens on it. Every training session, every early morning, every net in the off-season counts.
about.value_2_desc: For teammates, opponents, officials, and the game itself. Respect is the foundation of everything we do at Eden Roskill.
about.value_3_desc: To the crest, to your teammates, and to the culture that was built before you arrived. Loyalty is what turns a good cricketer into an Eden Roskill cricketer.
about.value_4_desc: We are one of Auckland's most multicultural clubs. Our diversity is our strength, and our community is what keeps players coming back season after season.

programs.heading: From your first over to Premier grade.
programs.sub: Every cricketer starts somewhere. Eden Roskill has structured programs for every age and ability, junior development, senior competition, and year-round indoor training.
programs.junior_body: Our junior program is the foundation of the club. We run age-grade teams from Under-9 through to Under-19, competing in Auckland Cricket Association competitions throughout the summer season.
programs.senior_body: Eden Roskill fields multiple senior teams across the Auckland Cricket Association competitions, from Premier Men at the top level through to club grade and social sides.
programs.training_body: Our indoor nets facility is available year-round for individual and group bookings. Whether you're preparing for the season or staying sharp in the off-season, the nets are open.

teams.heading: Every grade. Every level.
teams.sub: Eden Roskill fields eight teams across the Auckland Cricket Association, from Premier Men to social cricket. There is a place for every standard of player.
teams.premier_desc: Our flagship side competes in the ACA Premier Men's competition, the top grade of club cricket in Auckland.

contact.heading: Get in touch.
contact.manager_bio: Nitin has been part of the Eden Roskill family for over a decade, helping keep the club running smoothly behind the scenes. From registrations to ground bookings, he's the first point of contact for anything club-related.
contact.nets_body: Available for hire year-round. Contact us to check availability and book a session at Keith Hay Park.

baggy.hero_body: The highest honour at Eden Roskill Cricket Club. It is not given at registration. It is not handed out at the start of a season. It is earned through years of dedication, sacrifice, and loyalty to the club.
baggy.quote: You don't play for the baggy. You play well enough that the baggy finds you.
baggy.what_body_1: The baggy blue is the Premier cap of Eden Roskill Cricket Club. It is the symbol of having reached the top grade, Premier Men's cricket in the Auckland Cricket Association, and of everything it takes to get there.
baggy.what_body_2: When a player pulls on the baggy for the first time, they join a brotherhood of cricketers stretching back to 1903. They carry the legacy of everyone who wore it before them.
baggy.earned_sub: The baggy is awarded by the club when a player has demonstrated, over time, that they embody what Eden Roskill stands for. There is no fast track. You earn it.
baggy.cta_sub: The baggy starts with showing up. Register for the 2025/26 season, join the club, and begin writing your own chapter in Eden Roskill history.
